name: Baking
description: Baking word search puzzles gather warm-kitchen English for adults and seniors — flour, yeast, knead, proof, crust and calm oven words — without bakery brands or dessert-chain names. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays practical and domestic: batter, butter, loaf, pastry, muffin and glaze vocabulary many home bakers already know. This hub pairs well with Cooking and Kitchen when you want a longer pantry session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as gentle as a slow rise.
